lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.15-16 - A Listen. Then act it out. Audio track 85

details: Listen, then act it out checks and reinforces understanding of language and vocabulary in a story using visuals as an aid.
Look for careful listening of the story then confident repetition of story sentences.
“I get really bored in the evenings sometimes. What could I do for fun?”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (Listen and Follow): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (Video, then act it out): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.15-16 - B. Look and choose

details: Look and choose tests students’ understanding of the story using picture and word based MC questions.
Look for correct answers  and neat circling in students’ books.
“All my friends seem to do really cool things. Can you remember what they do?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:
Check and encourage Ss to complete the project prompts so that they are ready to present by lesson 7,

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book P.49 Page 16 - C Make your own story

details: Make your own story gives students the opportunity to personalise a story by circling words or stickers. Then they practise speaking by telling the story.
Look for accurate word choices and sticker placement inside the story pictures and confident story telling.
“I think I might join a tennis club. How about you?”
